title: Protocol of living cell separation using the microfluidic dielectrophoresis integrated chip
protocol: Turn on the computer power switch.
Turn on the cell-sorting device power switch.
Double-click the cell-sorting device software icon to open the operation screen.
Equilibrate buffer to room temperature before use to avoid condensation.
Equilibrate sample media to room temperature to avoid condensation.
Equilibrate alive Jurkat cell culture and dead Jurkat cell culture to room temperature.
Measure cell density and survival rate with a cell counter.
Dilute both cell cultures to approximately 1 × 10^6 cells/mL with sample media.
Mix live and dead cell cultures at approximately 50:50 to prepare 50% viability at 1 × 10^6 cells/mL (total of alive and dead cells).
Remove aluminum cover from the chip.
Place the chip, still covered in a sterile pouch, into a vacuum desiccator.
Close the lid of the vacuum desiccator.
Start the vacuum and slowly degas using an arbitrary generator for exactly 5 minutes.
Turn off the vacuum once the degassing time is complete.
Slowly release the vacuum state until the gauge reaches 0 MPa.
Open the vacuum desiccator lid.
Remove the chip from the sterile pouch immediately after opening the desiccator.
Proceed to install the decompressed chip into the cell-sorting device.
Do not touch the inlet and outlet ports after removing the chip from the sterile pouch.
Place the chip on the glass stage of the cell-sorting device while holding Chip Lock Lever by hand.
Ensure that Inlet 1 and Inlet 2 are in the left corner of the chip.
Push the chip until it latches securely.
Ensure the Chip Device Lever is up before pushing the chip to avoid probe unit damage.
Lock Chip Device Lever to set the chip position.
Equilibrate buffer at room temperature before use to prevent condensation.
Take out the longer tube from a tube set and connect it to a syringe.
Draw buffer until it reaches 1/3 to 1/2 of the syringe volume manually.
Turn the syringe tip upward and tap to move air from the tube.
Push the piston to remove all air.
Ensure no air bubbles remain in the system for constant flow rate.
Install the syringe to Syringe Pump 1 of the cell-sorting device.
Insert the other end of the buffer tube into Inlet port 1 attached to the chip.
Insert the end of the buffer tube into Inlet port 1 and the sample tube into Inlet port 2.
Ensure the buffer tube is fully inserted to Inlet port 1 to prevent it from popping off during cell sorting operation.
Click Push Plate Fast Descending Button of buffer on the software.
Press once to descend the push plate until it touches the syringe plunger.
Hold the Push Plate Descending Button to fill the chip with buffer until it drips from all ports.
Ensure there is no air left in the chip during filling.
Continue feeding buffer for more than 10 minutes before proceeding.
Equilibrate the sample at room temperature.
Remove the shorter tube from the kit, designated for sample use.
Connect the sample tube to a syringe and draw the sample into it using the same procedure as with the buffer.
Install the syringe containing the sample on Syringe Pump 2.
Position the sample tube near Outlet port 3.
Click the plunger Fast Descending button of the sample in the software.
Press once to descend and stop the push plate when it touches the syringe plunger.
Press and hold the fluid delivery button on the sample side until a drop comes out from the end of the sample tube.
Ensure Inlet port 2 is filled with buffer.
Insert the sample tube into Inlet port 2.
Ensure no air bubbles enter into Inlet port 2.
Adjust screen brightness with Brightness Adjustment Dial located below the syringe pump compartment.
Use Left/Right Adjustment Knob to capture the screen.
Use Front/Rear Adjustment Knob to capture the screen.
Focus images with Focus Adjustment Knob.
Set output method for CH1 and CH2 on the waveform control panel.
Select continuous if target cells are to be collected continuously.
Otherwise, select ON/OFF.
If continuous is deselected, enter liquid feed time.
Enter 33 minutes as the liquid feed time in this study.
Set frequency using the ▲ ▼ buttons.
Enter 3,000 kHz as the frequency in this study.
Set voltage using the ▲ ▼ buttons.
Enter 14 Vpp as the voltage in this study.
Press Liquid Transfer Start/Stop button on the syringe control panel for buffer.
Start feeding buffer before sample to stabilize flow.
Feed buffer for 30 seconds for a 1 mL syringe or 5 minutes for a 10 mL syringe.
Remove buffer accumulated in Outlet port 1 using sterile pipettes.
Empty Outlet port 2 using sterile pipettes.
Empty Outlet port 3 using sterile pipettes.
Press Liquid Transfer Start/Stop button on the syringe control panel for sample.
Pass 1 mL sample through the system, containing a ratio of live cells to dead cells of 50:50 (total 1 × 10^6 cells/mL).
Transfer separated cells from Outlet port 1 and Outlet port 2 using sterile pipettes into sterile containers.
Measure cell density and survival rate of samples collected from Outlet port 1 and Outlet port 2 with a cell counter.
Analyze collected cells in Outlet port 1 and Outlet port 2 using the analysis function of the software.
Press Analysis Tab to display the analysis screen.
Click File Selection button to select a video file to be analyzed.
Set a branch point by aligning the horizontal line with the middle of the flow path branch and setting the vertical line at the measurement position.
Set the analysis area if needed, or uncheck the Analysis Area check box if not required.
Click Analysis Start button to begin the analysis.
Check the degree of cell recognition and adjust settings as necessary.
Ensure all settings are correct before pressing Analysis Stop button.
Reset the count using Count Reset button if needed.
Start cell counting.
Set a play speed for the video and specify start and stop positions.
Click Analysis Start button to execute video analysis of selected section.
Press Count CSV Output button on the analysis screen.
Save the file.
Remove syringes from Syringe Pump 1 and Syringe Pump 2.
Remove tubes from Inlet port 1 and Inlet port 2.
Raise Chip Mounting Lever.
While pushing Chip Lock Lever by hand, move the chip forward.
Ensure Chip Mounting Lever is up to avoid probe damage.
Remove the chip from the glass stage.
Click “x” at top right corner of operation screen.
Turn off the computer.
Turn off power switch on the right side of the cell-sorting device.
Measure the cell density and survival rate of samples collected from Outlet port 1 and Outlet port 2 using a cell counter.
Dilute collected cells in RPMI 1640 medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum, 100 U/mL penicillin, and 100 mg/mL streptomycin to approximately 5 × 10^4 cells/mL.
Dispense 1 mL of the diluted culture into 12-well plates.
Incubate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere.
Prepare two controls containing live cells only, one with and one without passing through the cell-sorting system.
Record cell counts from Outlet 1, Outlet 2, and controls every 24 hours up to 4 days.
